decision_rule: Admit a candidate only if M62-level behavior is retained and normal recurrent history outperforms reset or zero-response ablations on response-critical seeds.
failure_criteria: aggregate success or clearance margin regresses versus M62
actor coupling washes out M98 hidden-envelope probe gains

hypothesis: A guarded actor-coupling continuation from M98 can make the actor use the learned hidden-envelope belief without losing M62 behavior.
success_criteria: starts from an M98 strict objective-pass checkpoint
uses no hidden or oracle actor inputs
retains M62-level behavior on shared-seed benchmark
normal recurrent behavior beats reset and zero-response ablations
